verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions datasets, and no CLI command or API documents triggering an eval run. The CLI covers issues, runs, signals and analytics, and a marketing line says releases are 'scored ... in CI', but neither amounts to an agent creating a dataset, launching an eval and reading back its results. No OpenAPI spec was found either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results
